parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the cluster to add.

parameters.name: DiscoveryOnly
parameters.description: Specifies whether to add the cluster for service discovery only.

parameters.name: IgnoreNamespaceCheck
parameters.description: Specifies whether to skip checking for the \`istio-system\` namespace in the target cluster. This parameter is typically used when you migrate from a self-managed Istio instance to ASM.

parameters.name: ServiceMeshId
parameters.description: The ID of the Service Mesh (ASM) instance.
